# Muazam Mughal

> Muazam Mughal is a Full-Stack Developer based in Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan, with 2+ years of experience building web and mobile applications with Laravel, Node.js, Next.js, React, Vue.js and React Native. He is a Software Engineer at AlphaSoft360 and holds a BS in Software Engineering from the Virtual University of Pakistan.
